data.why: the repo bundles test_generator_2.edf as the sample EDF recording the app's upload control is meant to accept; the app itself also generates synthetic EEG data on demand

goals: generate a synthetic imagined-speech EEG trial and inspect its raw multichannel waveform
upload a real EDF recording and have it band-pass filtered, resampled and epoched
view the MNE scalp topographic map of activity for the current epoch
get the CNN-LSTM model's predicted phoneme class and per-class probability distribution
compare the model's prediction against the synthetic ground-truth phoneme label
review training-history and confusion-matrix panels summarizing model performance

review.summary: The tree captures what the 'Original EEG App' is for: load a synthetic or EDF trial, look at its waveforms and scalp map, and read the pretrained CNN-LSTM's phoneme prediction with probabilities, at a sensible depth, with faithful labels and screenshots that match their nodes. It needs fixes before filing: t2's branch type and stray actions, a wrong channel count, and three limits stated as fact rather than hedged (synthetic labels are always /a/, only the first EDF epoch is used, and the training panels can't appear).
